""Dr Dev Swarup Shastri""(born""Bhudev Sharma""on 12 september 1987) is an Indian Astrologer,Vastu expert Numerologist and kxarmakand Acharya. He is known for his
expertise in Vedic Sciences and spiritual counseling,having analyzed over 250,000 horoscopes globally.He Has over 19+ years of professional experience inthe field.
Early Life and education
Dev Swarup was born in Agra ,Utter Pradesh ,India .he completed his graduation DR Bhim Rao Ambedkar University Agra from yung age,he devloped a deep interest in astrology,spiritual science and hindu rituals.
career
Dev swarup began practicing astrology professionally in 2005.His work spans:
. Vedic Astrology
.Vastu Shastra
.Numerology
.Swar Vigyan
.Nadi Astrology
.Hindu Karmakand (rituals)
Spiritual and mental wellness guidance
He has provided astrological consultations to Bollywood celebrities and international clients.He is also launching a digital platform for astrology and spiritual services
Dr. Dev Swarup Shastri: Exploring Vastu, Numerology, and Nadi Astrology with Bollywood Stars Anupam Kher and Jackie Shroff
Awards and recognition
In March 2025 ,he received Master of Vedic Science award from Blindwink, presented By Bollywood actress Bipasha Basu.
The Best Iconic Award for 2023 was bestowed upon Dr. Dev Swarup Shastri
media coverage
